INEOS Styrolution's sheet for Luran S 778T SPF30 Black 28214 (R-INEOS-LURAN-S778T-TDS), a black colour of an ASA injection-moulding grade, prints a density of 1070 kg/m³ (ISO 1183) and a water absorption of 1.65 % saturated at 23 °C and 0.35 % at equilibrium at 23 °C / 50 % RH (ISO 62), p. 2. The figures are a coloured grade's, not the natural resin's.
